notes.title: Introducing SST v0.7.6.0 - Electricity & Machines ALPHA
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_eifOfd4VbI;full][/previewyoutube]

- electricity & machines (Cosmos.electricity checkbox)
- new materials for machines gameplay: acrylic glass, plastic, solar panel, rotator, jet, laser
- pin/unpin brush and draw mode
- basic shifted multilayers mechanics
- SDraw - draw selection
- gears (draw gear by selection over shifted metal, then alt+click in Shift mode on selection to make upper layer gear by selection)
- engines, lasers (you should edit material to make it works with enough power)
- keyboard control (maybe, not sure imported yet, try to set some ascii character integer code to the Node.control field)

notes.title: SST v0.7.1.9 - Two GPU / Laptops startup crash fix solution [part 3]
notes.content:
- solution box helps to check the nVidia/AMD card is primary on systems with two GPU's
- many laptops configs affected
- safe mode (--no_vbo flag auto activation on errors)
- try to run SST twice for check if your system affected (dialog box will appear on second load)

notes.title: SST v0.7.1.8 - Windows 11 black screen fix solution [part 2]
notes.content:
- Windows 11 black screen 10 minutes time loading solution box
- new version detects it and shows solution box on the next start
- (try to run SST twice)
- press OK and install patch in the opened browser window

P.S. solution is to install the "Microsoft OpenCL and OpenGL compatibility pack"
